messages:
rachel_sales: Hey team - Quick ask: Pegasus wants to run a 30min POC spike next Wed 09:00 PT. They expect ~200 concurrent short chat sessions. Can we temporarily change pool settings so warmup + burst are covered and ensure we have an ephemeral hosted fallback key if Dedicated hits errors?

 tom_infra: Which pool and what targets? We can raise max_instances, add a prewarm period, and enable graceful drain. Also need an authorization for temp burst credits.

 rachel_sales: Pool: pool-PEG-POC-04. Proposal: prewarm 20m with min_instances=10, burst max_instances=50 (from 12), burst.mult=3, burst.duration=1h. Enable graceful_drain=true and set scaleDown.cooldown=300s. Demo window 2026-05-06T16:00Z-17:00Z. Billing: Kara will confirm temporary credits.

 tom_infra: Got it. Will set fallback-route to hosted-api-key:proj-pegasus-ephemeral and canary_fallback=25% then scale if 5xx>3% for 2m. Applying timed change with auto-rollback at 17:00Z.

 arman_engineering: For 200 concurrent short chats (avg 40 tokens) we saw p50 ~70ms and <1% 5xx when target instances=40 in previous tests. Setting max=50 should be safe. Make sure instance_type stays at standard-infer to avoid larger cost.

 kara_ae: I'll approve burst credits. Billing-bot, please create a temporary charge or credit estimate for the window.

 billing-bot: action:credit.create pending - amount=USD 1800 purpose="Pegasus POC burst" approver=kara_ae ts=1832110150

 tom_infra: CLI used:

 rwctl dedicated update-pool \
   --pool-id pool-PEG-POC-04 \
   --min-instances 10 \
   --max-instances 50 \
   --burst-multiplier 3 \
   --burst-duration 1h \
   --prewarm 20m \
   --graceful-drain true \
   --scale-down-cooldown 300 \
   --fallback-route hosted-api-key:proj-pegasus-ephemeral \
   --rollback-time 2026-05-06T17:00Z

 deploy-bot: action:pool.update success - pool=pool-PEG-POC-04 user=tom_infra ts=1832110225 details="min=10 max=50 burst_mult=3 duration=1h prewarm=20m graceful_drain=true cooldown=300 rollback=2026-05-06T17:00Z"

 kara_ae: Credit approved. billing-bot, mark as approved.

 billing-bot: action:credit.approve complete - id=ch_peg_1122 ts=1832110255 notes="Pegasus POC"

 arman_engineering: I'll add a short runbook: watch 5xx rate, tail latency, and autoscaler target. If errors >2% for 1m, trigger immediate rollback to previous pool sizing and switch 50% traffic to hosted fallback.

 rachel_sales: Thanks all. I'll update Pegasus and share the ephemeral key and access details. Tom, please post any anomalies here during the window. :rocket:
